name: Media Studio
description: Generate images, video and speech across providers (Gemini, OpenAI gpt-image-2, Qwen, Veo, LTX 2.3/2.5, DashScope) from one surface. Pick a mode, model and parameters; renders queue in the background with live progress and survive a reload, and everything under output/ lands in a filterable gallery with a lightbox and inline playback. Drives the built-in TextToImage / ImageToImage / TextToVideo / ImageToVideo / TextToSpeech tools directly.
